reviews.title: The game should not have this many packages!! 🥲
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing kakao for almost 7 years now, and I’m happy to see the game is finally playable in English, but with both games there are problems:
The costumes are way too expensive? $13 USD for a cookie costume is horrendous especially when it’s not obtainable otherwise..
SS cookies require soulstones to level up/unlock, which soulstones can only be obtained through packages or shorter events. Why is this game so heavy on purchases now and why are there so many of these cookies in the first place??? With Marshmallow Bunny and Strawberry Shortcake their special currency is obtainable through episode boxes or sending lives, which makes them actually possible to obtain for a free to play player. I get SS cookies are special but they are seriously impossible to get without being there for their release or buying their package.
The meta is changing way too fast also, I get it’s inevitable for meta in games to change but I feel like every week there’s some new meta I need to grind to obtain and it’s hard to keep up with.
I’m also confused with how the translations have changed for the worse since line cookie run. Primeval Jungle? Ghost pirate’s island of coins? Those names were just fine for these episodes and there was no need to change them.
Same for the cookie descriptions directly ripped from kingdom.

as a cookie run player of 7 yearsi love this game. i stopped playing ovenbreak since it was way harder to get cookies and pets through the gacha system. i never got to play cookie run line/kakao and im so happy!!
a main problem i have is sending lives to friends. you have to scroll through your friends list and do it manually. i have almost 160 friends and it takes me around 2 minutes to send lives (minus the mailbox)
also the costumes cost actual money. is there a way to collect things instead of having to buy them? under than these issues this game is so much better than any cookie run game i’ve played over the years. thank you so much devsisters for bringing this game back <3

reviews.title: Unfairly banned
reviews.text: I’m a long time fan of Cookie Run, I played back when it was called LINE Cookie Run! I was enjoying the old classic game as a trip down memory lane when my account was banned for illegitimate creation. I still don’t understand what I did to warrant that, as I never cheated or used outside tools to make my account. Contacting support they refused to reinstate my account, saying the ban was final. However the entire experience has soured me on Classic, so I can’t in good conscience recommend this game as you can be banned for no reason and just lose all your progress.

They rack up so much points and it’s hard for new players to catch up. They need to be put in separate lobby runs.
